sfx/door_chime.request: Convenience store automatic door opening with a short two-tone electronic entry chime.

sfx/can_drop.request: Vending machine: a drink can drops and clunks into the tray.

ambience/street_night.request: Quiet city street at night: distant traffic hum, a faint electric buzz from a shop sign, occasional far-away scooter, crickets.

sfx/meow_calm.request: A single short relaxed meow from an adult house cat, close mic.

sfx/meow_annoyed.request: A single short grumpy low meow from an annoyed house cat, close mic.

sfx/meow_smug.request: A single short chirpy, self-satisfied trill-meow from a chubby house cat, close mic.

sfx/blip.request: Tiny soft UI text blip, retro game dialogue tick.

bgm/night_street.request: Gentle lo-fi night theme for a 1990s Chinese PC RPG set in a modern city: warm electric piano, soft erhu melody, light brushed drums, nostalgic and a little lonely, seamless loop feel, no vocals.

bgm/campus_afternoon.request: Warm, unhurried afternoon theme for a 1990s Chinese PC RPG set on a modern university campus: plucked guzheng and soft acoustic guitar, light flute melody, gentle hand percussion, nostalgic and sunny with a hint of mystery, seamless loop feel, no vocals.

ambience/campus_day.request: University campus on a sunny afternoon: birds chirping in plane trees, rustling leaves, distant students chatting, an occasional bicycle bell far away.

sfx/page_turn.request: Paper notice flapping and a page being turned on a bulletin board.

sfx/footsteps_stone.request: A few soft sneaker footsteps on stone pavement, then stop.

vo/nika_12.request: 林夏: [gasps] 刚才……是猫在说话吗？

sfx/bike_bell.request: A classic bicycle thumb bell rung twice, bright ding-ding, outdoors.

sfx/coin_pick.request: A single small metal coin picked up from stone pavement, light bright clink.

sfx/coin_splash.request: A small coin tossed into a fountain pool: a short flick, then a tiny plop splash in water.

sfx/sparrow_flush.request: A small flock of tree sparrows chirping and suddenly flapping away together, light quick wingbeats, outdoors.

ambience/tenement_alley.request: Narrow back alley between old Chinese apartment blocks in the afternoon: a distant radio playing opera, a wok sizzling through an open window, mahjong tiles clacking far away, pigeons cooing, a bicycle rattling past.

ambience/overpass_day.request: Under a city highway overpass in the daytime: heavy traffic rumbling overhead with rhythmic expansion-joint thumps, scooters passing on the street below, distant market vendors calling, pigeons cooing nearby.

bgm/old_town.request: Lively but wistful daytime theme for a 1990s Chinese PC RPG set in the old quarter of a river city: plucked pipa and yangqin melody over warm upright bass and light street-band percussion, a touch of accordion, bustling and nostalgic, seamless loop feel, no vocals.

bgm/outskirts.request: Sparse, dreamlike theme for a 1990s Chinese PC RPG set on the unfinished outskirts of a city where the world looks half-drawn: soft xiao flute and music-box celesta over slow warm synth pads and distant bell tones, gentle and slightly uncanny, curious rather than scary, seamless loop feel, no vocals.

ambience/wireframe_estate.request: Empty unfinished housing estate on the edge of a city: steady wind over bare concrete and scaffolding, a loose tarp flapping, a faint electrical hum, crows cawing in the distance, no people.

ambience/river_ferry.request: Old river ferry pier on a breezy day: wide river water lapping against concrete steps and wooden pilings, a ferry horn sounding far away, seagulls calling, ropes creaking, light wind.

sfx/step_stone_1.request: One single clearly audible sneaker footstep on stone pavement, close mic, crisp heel-toe tap, dry, no reverb.

sfx/step_stone_2.request: One single clearly audible sneaker step on gritty concrete, close mic, short crunchy scuff, dry.

sfx/step_stone_3.request: One single quiet rubber-soled footstep on a stone tile, close, short scuff.

ambience/dyeworks_yard.request: Abandoned textile dye factory yard: water dripping into puddles, wind whistling through broken windows, an old metal sheet creaking, a distant crow, a faint hum of an old transformer.

sfx/door_wood.request: An old wooden dormitory door being pushed open with a short creak and a soft latch click.

ambience/breakwater_wind.request: Concrete breakwater by the sea: waves washing against the stones, strong steady sea wind, seagulls crying overhead, occasional spray splash.

sfx/door_glass.request: A heavy glass library door swinging open with a soft rubber seal whoosh and a light metal handle click.

sfx/sparrow_chirp_1.request: A single tree sparrow chirping twice, cheep cheep, close, outdoors, no other birds.

sfx/door_metal.request: A heavy rusty iron boiler-room door scraping and creaking open, then a dull metal clank.

sfx/sparrow_chirp_2.request: Two tree sparrows exchanging quick bright chirps, outdoors, close.

sfx/sparrow_chirp_3.request: One tiny sparrow giving a short sharp alarm chirp, outdoors, close.

sfx/sparrow_flush_1.request: A small flock of tree sparrows suddenly flapping away together with startled chirps, light quick wingbeats, outdoors.

sfx/sparrow_flush_2.request: Two or three sparrows taking off from the ground, a quick flutter of small wings and one alarmed chirp, outdoors.

sfx/sparrow_flush_3.request: A single small bird bursting into flight, short sharp wing flutter, outdoors.

sfx/pigeon_chirp_1.request: A city pigeon cooing softly, low throaty coo-roo-coo, close, outdoors.

sfx/pigeon_chirp_3.request: A single short pigeon coo, close, outdoors.

sfx/pigeon_chirp_2.request: Two pigeons cooing and murmuring together on a ledge, low and throaty, outdoors.

sfx/pigeon_flush_1.request: Several city pigeons taking off at once, loud clapping wingbeats, outdoors.

sfx/pigeon_flush_2.request: One pigeon flapping up from the pavement, two loud wing claps then gliding away, outdoors.

sfx/pigeon_flush_3.request: A small group of pigeons fluttering up and resettling nearby, heavy wing flaps, outdoors.

sfx/gull_chirp_1.request: A single seagull crying, a long laughing kee-ow call, outdoors by the water.

sfx/gull_chirp_3.request: One seagull giving a short sharp squawk, close, outdoors.

sfx/gull_chirp_2.request: Two seagulls calling to each other, short squawks, outdoors by the sea.

sfx/gull_flush_1.request: A few seagulls taking off from the ground with heavy slow wingbeats and squawks, outdoors by the sea.

sfx/crow_chirp_1.request: A single crow cawing twice, caw caw, outdoors, slight distance.

sfx/gull_flush_2.request: One seagull lifting off with two big wing flaps and an annoyed squawk, outdoors.

sfx/gull_flush_3.request: A seagull flapping up into the wind with a long cry, outdoors by the water.

sfx/crow_chirp_2.request: Two crows calling back and forth, rough caws, outdoors.

sfx/crow_chirp_3.request: One crow giving a short low rattling croak, close, outdoors.

sfx/crow_flush_1.request: Two crows taking off from the ground with heavy wingbeats and harsh alarmed caws, outdoors.

sfx/crow_flush_2.request: A single crow flapping up with three heavy wingbeats and one harsh caw, outdoors.

sfx/crow_flush_3.request: A crow bursting off a fence with loud flapping and a startled caw, outdoors.
